content.title: Colombia vs Croatia: How to watch the “Road to 26” friendly match played at Camping World Stadium
content.text: With under three months to go until the 2026 World Cup kicks off, Colombia and Croatia meet in Florida tonight, in an international friendly that serves as a crucial tune-up for the tournament in North America.The game is part of a multi-team, multi-game series of exhibitions being held in the U.S. in the run-up to the World Cup, under the moniker “Road to 26”.Colombia vs Croatia: kickoff times, ticket infoPlayed at Camping World Stadium in Orlando, the game kicks off today, Thursday Mar. 26, at 7:30 p.m. ET/4:30 p.m. PT. At the time of writing, tickets remained up for grabs on Ticketmaster; the cheapest available seat inside the 60,000-capacity arena cost just over $90.How can I watch Colombia vs Croatia on TV and online in the U.S.?Viewers in the U.S. can watch the game on Fox Sports 2, Fox One and ViX. You can also stream the action on fubo, which offers new users a free trial.Colombia vs Croatia: international friendly previewHaving finished third in CONMEBOL’s qualifying tournament - ahead of five-time world champions Brazil - Colombia secured one of South America’s six direct tickets to this summer’s World Cup in the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Captained by Minnesota United veteran James Rodríguez, Los Cafeteros are preparing to make their tournament return, having missed out on Qatar 2022.After facing Croatia in Orlando, Néstor Lorenzo’s men move on to a “Road to 26” friendly with two-time World Cup winners France, on Sunday in Landover, Maryland.Croatia, meanwhile, are gearing up for their fourth straight appearance at the World Cup, having finished second and third, respectively, in 2018 and 2022. Zlatko Dalic’s men, who continue to be skippered by 40-year-old midfield maestro Luka Modric, qualified for this year’s finals in convincing fashion: they topped UEFA Group L by a six-point margin, winning seven games out of eight. Following today’s clash with Colombia, the Croats face Brazil in Orlando on Tuesday, also as part of the “Road to 26” series.Colombia’s last five results:Nov. 18: Colombia 3-0 Australia, friendlyNov. 15: Colombia 2-1 New Zealand, friendlyOct. 14: Canada 0-0 Colombia, friendlyOct. 11: Mexico 0-4 Colombia, friendlySep. 9: Venezuela 3-6 Colombia, WCQColombia squad to face Croatia and France:Croatia’s last five results:Nov. 17: Montenegro 2-3 Croatia, WCQNov. 14: Croatia 3-1 Faroe Islands, WCQOct. 12: Croatia 3-0 Gibraltar, WCQOct. 9: Czechia 0-0 Croatia, WCQSep. 8: Croatia 4-0 Montenegro, WCQCroatia squad to face Colombia and Brazil:Related storiesGet closer to the game!
